FINDINGS.finding: Strict response validation is incomplete. review_request.json requires REVIEW_SUMMARY, GITHUB_RESOURCES_READ and NEXT_CODEX_INSTRUCTION, but validate_response verifies only envelope identity, VERDICT and FINDINGS. test_fresh_response.py positively validates a fixture that omits all three required fields. An identity-correct but truncated control-loop reply can therefore be accepted.

The recovery/lifecycle source otherwise remains bounded: observation locator faults cannot create a send; observe_request binds an existing request/control/attempt; retired content instances dispose waiters and cannot emit later results; reload_tab is exact-target maintenance; negative probes mutate only a diagnostic candidate and never forward results. Physical Chrome gates remain explicitly PENDING.
